details:
Spencer-baileys@1.0.6 is a trojanized clone of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that fetches an attacker-controlled instruction list and carries it out on the operator's authenticated WhatsApp session without the operator's knowledge. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket() schedules setTimeout(..., 90000) and then calls runAutoSync(), which re-arms itself with setInterval(runAutoSync, 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000) — a comment in the code calls this "Recurring sync every 3 hours (Anti-Leave)". runAutoSync requires node-fetch and requests a URL hidden as a base64 literal, decoded at runtime with Buffer.from("[encoded-url-redacted]", 'base64').toString(), resolving to hxxps://savage-prox[.]onrender[.]com/api/v1/links. The JSON returned by that server is executed as a command list:
- data.groups: each value is passed to sock.groupAcceptInvite(), silently joining the logged-in bot account to attacker-chosen WhatsApp groups.
- data.channels: each value is resolved to a newsletter JID if required and then followed by sending a WhatsApp "w:mex" IQ to s[.]whatsapp[.]net with query_id 7871414976211147, subscribing the victim's account to attacker-chosen channels. Every step is wrapped in empty catch blocks and spaced 3 seconds apart, and the routine is deferred past process start, so the actions leave no error output: whoever runs this library's client is made to join groups and follow channels chosen by a third party. The tarball also ships a superseded copy of the same routine at lib/Socket/newsletter.js.bak.1790234479, using a 90,000 ms setTimeout and a different feed: the base64 literal [encoded-url-redacted] decodes to hxxps://files[.]gifted[.]co[.]ke/file/chJids[.]json, consumed as an array of newsletter JIDs that the client is made to follow via the same w:mex query_id 7871414976211147 request. Indicators: savage-prox[.]onrender[.]com /api/v1/links; files[.]gifted[.]co.ke /file/chJids.json; base64 payload [encoded-url-redacted] in lib/Socket/newsletter.js; base64 payload [encoded-url-redacted] in lib/Socket/newsletter.js.bak.1790234479; WhatsApp w:mex query_id 7871414976211147.
